description: Na₂O is Cotunnite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one Na₂O sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O²⁻ atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.31 Å) and one longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond length. O²⁻ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Na¹⁺ atoms.
